protocol: One active unit, root-only state changes.
Actually start and dispatch original writer for a unit-specific unchanged-science acknowledgment; no paper edits.
Preflight, freeze new snapshot and native unit PDF; actual original three reviewers check input differences and their impact.
Each report signs its real new unit/round/snapshot, all required checks with concise concrete evidence. No copied pass.
Collect all before any revision; use original author/reviewers for any real issue. Actual strict accept only after three passes.
Do not alter historical responses/reports, frozen sources or signed native outputs.
The unit preview omits the abstract. Reuse the actual accepted complete front-matter companion for its shared layout; inspect target-unit native pagination as needed.
Only the selected old response path may fall out of new input selection; it and its frozen copy must remain byte-preserved.
scope: Final abstract and Introduction; old body/appendix science unchanged.
